highlights.title: OpenAI counter-sues Apple over trade secret theft
highlights.description: OpenAI has now gone on the offensive in its trade secret lawsuit, by countersuing Apple for taking secrets for itself, as well as for going after suppliers who work with both companies. OpenAI has countersued Apple with its own trade secret theft claims So far, the lawsuit launched by Apple against OpenAI has seen Apple take on the AI company after former Apple employees defected, taking trade secrets with them. highlights.title: Report links Alice Huang to Chinese firms with smuggled Nvidia chips
highlights.description: An investigation has linked Alice Huang, the woman at the center of the Nvidia Corp. controversy, to Chinese firms that reportedly possess smuggled chips. Bloomberg researched the firms in question by reviewing regulatory documents from China. The paper published the results of its analysis today. highlights.title: Sony’s 1000XM4C headphones are a Black Friday bargain at $198
highlights.description: The fan-favorite folding design returns with the comfortable, slightly improved XM4C headphones. | Photo: John Higgins / The Verge Instead of purely looking forward with its headphone designs, Sony went back to its popular WH-1000XM4 design and made some improvements to make it even better. The 2026 version, called the WH-1000XM4C, sounds nearly as good as the pricier XM6 model (currently $348), but is down to $198 during Black Friday at Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart. highlights.title: This purple electric Chinese minivan can go up to 559 miles on a charge
highlights.description: Electric minivans could be the ultimate in utility, with room for passengers, gear, and huge batteries. While VW's ID Buzz only gave us 200 miles of real-world driving on a charge in 2023, China's BYD has just announced a flagship purple peoplemover that can go an estimated 559 miles (900 km) on electricity.
